challenges.code:
TEAMS = [
    ("team_data", {"cloud": "aws"}),
    ("team_ml", {"cloud": "gcp"}),
    ("team_apps", {"cloud": None}),
]

def choose_channel(req):
    cloud = req.get("cloud")
    if cloud == "aws":
        return "bedrock"
    if cloud == "gcp":
        return "vertex"
    return "direct_api"

channels = []
for name, req in TEAMS:
    channel = choose_channel(req)
    channels.append(channel)
    print(f"{name}: {channel}")
print(f"channels_used={len(set(channels))}")
